text_block_list.text: Today is the first day of summer camp. It's a period of intense training where racers can improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Current temperature—twenty-eight degrees Celsius. Relative humidity—seventy-eight percent. This is an average summer day in July.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The heat is expected to grow more intense in the coming days. Please take adequate precautions against heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master. We must ensure that we hydrate periodically.
Mihono Bourbon takes out a water bottle from somewhere and hands it to me.
And so begins my blistering summer camp with Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: After summer, it'll be time for the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You can do this, Rice… Come on!
